entities.name: Zdeněk Humhal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zdeněk Humhal was a Czech volleyball player who competed for Czechoslovakia in the 1964 Summer Olympics. He was born in Prague. In 1964, he was part of the Czechoslovak team that won the silver medal in the Olympic tournament. He played eight matches.
